independence_declaration.statement: I (code-security-reviewer, session 42264c87) authored none of the DG1 implementation or the round-5 repairs: F-DG1-122, F-DG1-123 and F-DG1-211 were the orchestrator's (f75b334, 3e142d6), F-DG1-124 backend-workflow-engineer's (6465ed8), and F-DG1-204/205 came from round 2/3. I reported F-DG1-122/123/124 in round 4, and verifying them is the originating reviewer's role. At start HEAD was d3fcb89, a direct child of the freeze commit 5f83a336 that adds only candidate-excluded metadata (round-5 assignments, the candidate manifest, stages.json, QA test evidence). The recomputed candidate ID matched in the real repo (candidate.mjs, and --diff matches=true) and in a disposable clone checked out at 5f83a336. All code ran in disposable clones under my run's TMPDIR and on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 cluster (port 5497). I formed this verdict without reading any other reviewer's round-5 record; none existed in reviews/DG1/round-5/ when I wrote mine.

summary: PASS. Candidate sha256:24eb3779...b08e (commit 5f83a336). All five assigned fixes verify (F-DG1-122, F-DG1-123, F-DG1-124, F-DG1-204, F-DG1-205 -> CLOSED_VERIFIED). typecheck, build, lint, openapi:lint, no-cdn, format:check, unit 267/267, integration 200/200 x2 on fresh PostgreSQL 16, gate/agent tooling 105/105, deploy scripts 59/59, SBOM --check and DG0 historical all pass. The installer suite runs 12/13 here; AC-1 (effect) is BLOCKED by no registry access and PASSes in an offline equivalent. Two new Low, non-mandatory findings: F-DG1-125 (module lint misses native loaders reached via an import of node:process) and F-DG1-126 (copy-back member resolver reads every YAML list item and ignores '!' exclusions; not reachable with the committed pnpm-workspace.yaml). No Critical/High or mandatory violation remains in my scope.
